## 6. Research frontier — toward R90F10 (recall > 90% AND FAR < 10%)

**Primary operating point = PGD eps=0.030, window-level, white-box, seed-42 LeNet family.**

| Milestone | Definition | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **R90F10 (startup / research goal)** | recall > 0.90 AND FAR < 0.10 @ eps=0.030 | ❌ not met | `[research-goal]` |
| **F20 (thesis fallback)** | recall >= 0.80 AND FAR <= 0.20 @ eps=0.030 | ⚠️ post-hoc-only | `[val/post-hoc]` |
| **H15 @ eps=0.015** | recall > 0.85 AND FAR < 0.15 @ eps=0.015 | ✅ PASS | `[frozen-test]` |

- **Best validation frontier (PGD eps=0.030):** G1 LeNet (best checkpoint) PGD-AUROC **0.876**, recall@FAR≤10% ≈ 0.477 `[val-only]`. Six training-time interventions + BASAT (TRADES/GAIRAT/SAT) stall ~0.876; BiLSTM pivot worse (0.726). See REPRESENTATION_CEILING_CAPSTONE.md.
- **Advisor read:** R90F10 @ eps=0.030 will not come from more attempts in the closed LeNet score-axis family (test oracle there ~recall 0.533 @ FAR<=0.15); needs a new method class or a scoped lower-eps claim.

> **H15@ε=0.015 frozen PASS `[frozen-test]`:** TP 41/45, recall 0.9111 (Wilson 0.793-0.965), FAR 0.1319 (Wilson 0.104-0.166); clean recall 0.9778 / FAR 0.0901 at same tau. Clears recall>90% but **not** FAR<10%, and is at ε=0.015 — **not** R90F10 (ε=0.030).
